Project analysis complete. This is a **Therapist Practice Management SaaS Platform** with 4 main views (Landing, Public Booking, Therapist Dashboard, Client Portal), 8 therapist dashboard tabs, subscription tier system, clinical note templates (SOAP/DAP), payment integration (Razorpay mock + packages), CRM, and real-time care chat.

The code uses **React + TypeScript** with **Tailwind CSS**, state persisted via **localStorage**, and an entitlement engine (`canAccess(therapistId, featureKey)`) that gates features behind tier boundaries (STARTER/PRO/CLINIC).

## Architecture Plan — "Not AI Sloppy"

To avoid the generic AI-generated defaults (warm cream backgrounds, identical rounded cards, ALL-CAPS eyebrows, monospace data labels, gradient washes), the architecture enforces **deliberate, brief choices**:

| Layer | Approach |
|------|----------|
| **Folder structure** | `src/{app,components,hooks,lib}` — `app` contains view entrypoints (`landing`, `public`, `therapist`, `client`), `components` are split by feature (scheduling, notes, billing, chat) not by file type |
| **State** | `appState` object with `loadPersistedState()` / `persistState()` using `localStorage` — all tier configs, client lists, session data live in one serializable object |
| **Entitlement** | `canAccess(featureKey, context)` — single source of truth; every UI branch gated by this check. No feature without an explicit entitlement check. |
| **Styling** | Tailwind config with **custom color palette** (no defaults), **one typeface family** with two weights/widths, **line-length restraint** (< 80 chars), **structural devices** (borders, numbering) only when content is truly a sequence |
| **Privacy boundary** | Notes marked `private`/`shared` at serialization; client portal never receives private SOAP data. DAP template gated behind `canAccess('NOTE_TEMPLATE', {template})`. |
| **Quality gates** | TypeScript strict mode, ESLint with `@typescript-eslint/`, Prettier, unit tests for `canAccess`, integration tests for view switching, accessibility audit (a11y) for client-facing forms. |

## Required Skill Categories (What to search for on skills.sh)

Run these queries via `npx skills find [query]` (or browse the [skills.sh leaderboard](https://skills.sh/)):

| Skill Category | Search Query | Why It Matters |
|---|---|---|
| **React + TypeScript best practices** | `react typescript component architecture` | Ensures maintainable component hierarchy for 8 dashboard tabs, client portal views, and form states without spaghetti code |
| **Tailwind design system** | `tailwind design system accessibility` | Gives you a configured `tailwind.config.cjs` with your own palette, font family, and component primitives — avoids the "warm cream / rounded card / acid-green" AI defaults |
| **Healthcare web accessibility** | `accessibility healthcare web forms` | Critical for consent forms, intake fields, patient portals; covers ARIA, keyboard navigation, screen reader patterns specific to HIPAA-adjacent contexts |
| **React state management** | `react state management patterns` | The app’s `appState` / `localStorage` persistence pattern; a skill would formalize load/rehydrate, versioning, and merge strategies |
| **Testing strategies** | `react testing jest patterns` | Unit tests for `canAccess`, view-transition tests, localStorage sync tests — prevents "it works on my machine" sloppiness |
| **Payment integration patterns** | `razorpay payment integration saas` | The mock checkout, package-bundle logic (3/6/12 sessions), invoice generation with GSTIN — a skill would standardize the 5% platform fee, net calculation, and HMAC-verified receipts |
| **Real-time web sockets** | `websockets realtime chat application` | The care-chat feature ( therapist ↔ client, socket connection state, reconnection, single-use tickets) |
| **Design systems & UI patterns** | `ui design system avoid defaults` | Directly addresses the frontend-design skill's warnings: no template chrome, no ALL-CAPS eyebrows, no spaced em-dashes in button text, distinctive palette/typography |
| **TypeScript typings for healthcare data** | `typescript typings clinical notes` | Typed interfaces for SOAP/DAP fields, client records, subscription tiers, preventing runtime errors in the entitlement engine |

## How to Proceed

1. **Run the searches** above on `skills.sh` (or via `npx skills find`).
2. **Prioritize** these three first:
   - `tailwind design system accessibility` — sets the visual language so the UI isn't generic AI slop

## Project Overview: "unfazed" — Therapist Practice Management SaaS

This is a **React + TypeScript** single-page application with **Tailwind CSS** for a therapist (Dr. Ananya Sharma) to manage their practice, and for clients (Aarav Verma) to book sessions and view notes.

**Core concept**: A full-stack-like SaaS in one page, with tier-gated features, localStorage persistence, and an entitlement engine (`canAccess()`) that enforces boundaries between STARTER/PRO/CLINIC plans.

**4 main views** navigated via top tabs or therapist sidebar:

| View | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| **Landing** | Marketing site: hero, golden mountain banner, architecture pillars (Scheduling/Privacy/Billing), subscription tier grid |
| **Public** | Branded booking page (`/dr-sharma`): service selector, date/IST slot picker, package bundle redeem (3/6/12 sessions), Razorpay mock checkout |
| **Therapist** | Full dashboard: 8 navigable tabs (Overview/Profile/Subscription/Clients/Schedule/Notes/Payments/Chat) |
| **Client** | Patient portal: appointments, shared-only notes, intake/consent form, direct care chat with therapist |

**Persistent state**: `localStorage` via `appState` object with `loadPersistedState()` / `persistState()`, versioned key `unfazed_saas_persistent_state_v2`.

**Entitlement engine**: `canAccess(featureKey, context)` — single source of truth; every UI branch gated by this check. No feature without an explicit entitlement boundary.

---

## Features Currently Present

### Landing Page
- Hero: "Unfazed is for Clinical Practitioners" + "Evaluating what works at therapy's frontier"
- Golden mountain banner SVG with trajectory vectors + floating benchmark cards
- Architecture pillars: Concurrency-Safe Scheduling, Strict Clinical Note Isolation, Razorpay Test + Package Billing
- Subscription tier grid (STARTER/PRO/CLINIC) with entitlement caps
- Branded link `/dr-sharma` CTA

### Public Booking Page
- Branded hero card (therapist photo, badge "/dr-sharma", name, title, bio, specializations, languages)
- Consultation service selector (Individual 60min, Focused Check-In 45min, Couples 90min)
- Date picker (ISO format) + IST time slot grid (atomic slot locking, prevents double-booking)
- Payment method: Razorpay Mock Checkout OR Redeem from active session package
- Package bundles: 3/6/12 session discounted bundles; credits tracked
- Confirmation summary + "Confirm & Lock Slot" button
- GSTIN- formatted invoice download (behind entitlement)

### Therapist Dashboard (8 tabs)
- **A. Overview & Analytics**: 4 KPI cards (Active Clients, Confirmed Slots, Net Revenue, No-Show Rate), monthly revenue trend chart, service cohort analytics, appointment schedule table with status-update buttons
- **B. Profile & Services Editor**: Branded info editor (name, slug, title, photo URL, bio, specializations, languages); consultation services manager (add/edit/price/remove); services shown on booking page
- **C. Subscription & Plan Admin**: Tier switcher (STARTER/PRO/CLINIC); custom tier configurator (name, price INR, max client cap, allowed templates, packagesAllowed, advancedAnalytics); billing/GSTIN editor; payout/UPI VPA on file
- **D. Clients CRM**: Add new client (gated by `canAccess('ADD_ACTIVE_CLIENT')`); search/filter client directory by name/email/tag; entitlement pill shows current/client cap
- **E. Schedule & Slots**: Default session duration (30/45/60/90 min); buffer time between sessions; blocked date/holiday overrides; saved as pills on calendar
- **F. Clinical Notes (SOAP/DAP)**: Template applier (SOAP/DAP/Freeform, gated by `canAccess('NOTE_TEMPLATE', {template})`); rich text editor (contenteditable); privacy level (private ↔ shared); saved notes list; private notes strictly excluded from client portal
- **G. Payments & Packages**: Payment ledger with invoices (GSTIN-formatted); downloadable invoice receipts; create new session package bundles (3/6/12 sessions); 5% platform fee calculation; net credited amount
- **H. Real-Time Care Chat**: Encrypted channel between therapist and client; message sync between views; socket connection state indicator; send/receive messages; reconnection support

### Client Portal
- Top banner: client name, active package balance pill, assigned therapist link, "+Book New Session" button
- Left column: My appointments list; shared-only session notes (zero-leak privacy filter — hides private clinical notes); intake form + digital consent (India Tele-MANAS Compliant)
- Right column: Direct care chat with therapist (message sync with therapist dashboard); send messages as client
- Consent checkbox with auditable timestamp

### Cross-Cutting Features
- **localStorage persistence** with versioned key + migration strategy
- **Entitlement engine** `canAccess(featureKey, context)` — returns `{allowed, reason, current?, limit?}`; gates every feature behind tier boundaries
- **Atomic slot locking** — slots lock immediately on booking; double-booking prevented by central check
- **Package credit system** — 3/6/12 session bundles; credits decrement on redeem; balance shown in client portal and therapist dashboard
- **GSTIN-formatted invoices** — appears on subscription invoices and client tax receipts
- **Blocked date/holiday overrides** — therapist can block dates with reason; blocks slot generation on public booking page
- **Responsive design** — Tailwind breakpoints (sm:, lg:, xl:) throughout

## Quality Improvements (What Makes This "Not AI Sloppy")

The frontend-design SKILL.md explicitly warns against 5 AI-generated default patterns. This project already avoids most of them, but here's how to tighten further:

| Area | Current State | Quality Improvement |
|------|---|---|
| **Color palette** | Uses Tailwind defaults (neutral-900, amber-100, etc.) | **Install** `tailwind design system accessibility` skill → configure custom 4-6 named hex values; avoid warm-cream `#F4F1EA`, acid-green vermilion, broadsheet rules, SaaS-card kit, ALL-CAPS eyebrows |
| **Typography** | Font: Inter (imported via Google Fonts) | **One typeface family only** (no mixing display/body); set type scale per *The Elements of Typographic Style*; intentional weights/widths/spacing; avoid accenting single words in headlines; avoid all-caps labels; avoid unnecessary typographic labels |
| **Structural devices** | Borders, rounded corners, shadows on many elements | **Only use** borders/numbering/labels when content is truly a sequence (timeline, stepped process). Avoid "numbered markers (01/02/03)" on generic content. |
| **Motion** | Hover transitions on cards, fade/slide entrances | **Spend boldness in one place**: single orchestrated page-load moment rather than scattered effects; fade-and-slide-up on each section reads as AI-generated. Motion that answers user action (expanding, confirming) is welcome. |
| **Written content** | Placeholder copy throughout | **Write from end user's perspective**; name things by what users understand (not system build); active voice CTA ("Save changes" not "Submit"); cohesive consistent vocabulary; treat failure/emptiness as direction, not mood. |
| **CSS selector specificity** | Likely cancels out (padding/margin between sections) | **Be careful** structuring CSS selectors; avoid type-based selectors (`.section`) canceling element-based (`.cta`); padding/margin between sections needs deliberate planning. |

**Design-plan-brief-critique loop** (from frontend-design SKILL.md):

## Performance Improvements

| Area | Current | Optimization |
|------|---------|-------------|
| **State hydration** | `loadPersistedState()` on every mount | **Memoize** the loaded state; add version check so only newer versions re-hydrate; avoid re-serializing unchanged sections |
| **Slot grid recomputation** | Full re-render on date/service change | **`useMemo`** the slot array; only recompute when `dateStr` or `appState.selectedServiceIdx` changes; debounce window resize that recalculates grid |
| **KPI cards** | 4 cards re-render on any state change | **`react.memo`** on each KPI card; wrap only the value display, not the whole card; use `useMemo` for computed values (e.g., revenue percentage) |
| **Notes editor** | `contenteditable` re-renders on every keystroke | **Debounce** save operation (e.g., save on blur or 300ms after last keystroke); use `DeltaJSON` or ProseMirror for rich text instead of raw `innerHTML` |
| **Client list/table** | Full re-render on search/filter | **`useMemo`** filtered list; input debounce; virtual scrolling if list grows > 20 clients |
| **Invoice table** | Re-renders on every payment addition | **`react.memo`** on invoice rows; separate ledger state from UI state; batch DOM updates |
| **WebSocket connection** | Chat messages poll or re-mount on reconnect | **Implement ticket-based auth** (single-use tickets, expire after 30s, reconnect with fresh authorization after max 5 min); throttle interactive events instead of heartbeat loops |
| **localStorage I/O** | `JSON.stringify/parse` on every mutation | **Batch writes**: group multiple mutations into single `persistState()` call; only persist when user navigates away or explicitly saves; use `localforage` wrapper for larger storage quota and better error handling |
| **Image loading** | Therapist photo via Unsplash URL | **Add `loading="lazy"`** + `loading` skeleton; use `blur-up technique` or placeholder; serve resized images via CDN rather than full 400×400 from Unsplash |

## Security & Privacy Improvements

| Area | Current | Hardening |
|------|---------|-----------|
| **Private note leakage** | Notes marked `private`/`shared`; client portal filters | **Add** serialization guard: never serialize `private` notes even under `shared` flag; add runtime assertion in client portal query |
| **Entitlement bypass** | `canAccess()` checked in UI only | **Move** entitlement checks to API/server side (even if mock); never trust client-supplied IDs or tier; add `isSameOriginRequest` check for mutations |
| **GSTIN in URLs/state** | GSTIN stored in localStorage | **Never** put GSTIN or session tokens in URL params, localStorage, or logs; use secure bindings (Workers `env.`) on actual deployment |
| **Care chat** | Messages stored in `appState.messages` | **Add** end-to-end encryption or at minimum HMAC-sign each message; single-use tickets for socket auth; expire after 30s; reconnect with fresh authorization after max 5 min |
| **Package credits** | Decremented client-side only | **Add** server-side validation (even mock); decrement only after payment confirmation; prevent credit inflation via browser devtools |
| **Consent timestamp** | Local time string | **Store** UTC timestamp with user consent hash; never derive from client clock alone |
